text:
nora: Quick follow-up from BlueArch postmortem — short RC: scheduled peering change caused a transient flap, customer's on-prem NAT failover produced asymmetric return paths which triggered a conntrack/dup-session isolation bug. Need owners, hard dates, and a short validation drill to run with BlueHarbor SRE. Please confirm owners by COB.

samir: I'll own the peering-healthcheck work and CI gating. Plan: pre-deploy BGP neighbor check + a lightweight synthetic that verifies symmetric return next-hop for a small keyspace. Target: 2024-11-05.

eldra: I'll build the churn simulator for staging (BGP flap + NAT failover) and add pcap/tcptrace capture hooks. Need staging host and a bucket for pcaps. Proposed test window: 2024-11-07 14:00 PT.

tess: I'll take runbook updates and customer-facing remediation notes. Will add an explicit "isolation rollback" step and include the asymmetric-path checklist. ETA: 2024-11-04.

blueharbor-sre: Thanks — we can do the drill on 2024-11-07 morning in our window. Please cc our SRE alias (sre+blueharbor@blueharbor.io) when you lock the slot. We can also provide NAT failover test hooks if you need them.

ops-bot: Alert created: /alerts/peer-flap-rate-bluearch (threshold=3/min). Runbook linked: /runbooks/peering-isolation-bluearch.

samir: BGP check snippet to reuse in infra libs:

```
#!/bin/bash
# bgp-peer-sanity.sh
vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors" | egrep "Neighbor|State|Last update" || exit 1
```

eldra: For captures, use staging host: bluearch-stg-peers.int.redwood:11779. Upload pcaps to s3://redwood-artifacts/bluearch/pcaps and tag with customer:bluearch incident:iso-2024-11.

tess: Consolidated action items (please confirm here or reassign):
- samir: peering healthcheck + CI gate + symmetric-path synthetic (owner:samir) / due: 2024-11-05
- eldra: churn simulator + pcap capture + staging artifacts (owner:eldra) / due: 2024-11-07
- tess: runbook edits + customer remediation doc + rollback step (owner:tess) / due: 2024-11-04
- ops-bot: provision alert + annotate runbook (owner:ops-bot) / due: 2024-11-02

nora: We'll tag this in the recurring-incidents tracker as "asym-return-conntrack" and watch for correlated events across Dedicated/Private tenants. I'll add the rows to the remediation tracker and bring status to next remediation sync. If anyone reassigns ownership, post here so I can keep the timeline accurate.

blueharbor-sre: Confirmed on drill window. We'll standby for the calendar invite and the runbook link.

samir: I'll open the infra PR and link it here once ready.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: alert /alerts/peer-flap-rate-bluearch provisioned.
